chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of our companions, from one of the two (peace be upon them).

Regarding the man who excretes wind during the Obligatory Tawaaf, and he had circumambulated part of it. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should go out and perform ablution. So if he had completed the half, he would build upon his Tawaaf; and if it was less than half, he would repeat the Tawaaf'.

key_terms.بَنَى عَلَى طَوَافِهِ: Builds upon his circumambulation (continues from where he left off)
key_terms.يُحْدِثُ: Excretes wind / breaks minor ritual purity

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one breaks ritual purity during Tawaaf?
ai.summary: This ruling from al-Kafi highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle of 'building upon' (bina') partial validity, where the validity of the completed portion depends on whether it constitutes more than half of the total circuits. It reflects the practical application of ritual purity laws within the sacred precincts of Mecca, emphasizing that minor impurities do not necessarily invalidate the entire act of worship if the majority has been performed correctly.
